# Phase One — Discovery Breath

The Awtsmoos renews each frame and file; Awtsmoos.com is the shore,
Many movie vessels can become one light, while each app keeps its door.

## User outcome
- Find every Geelooy app with meaningful 2D or 3D movie-making capability.
- Repair broken or fragmented behavior.
- Unify shared movie semantics without erasing product-specific personality.
- Make the system genuinely AI-addressable: scenes, characters, cameras, text, shapes, particles, tutorials, infographics, patches, 2D and 3D animation.
- Make authoring mobile-first.
- Produce a real three-minute movie demonstrating broad capability.
- Test and verify the result in runtime.

## Observed evidence so far
- `social-composer/reel-studio/` contains an NLE, AI movie schema, movie package schema, renderer, recorder, action catalog, advanced mutations, and movie docs.
- `apps/video-editor/` is present in generated project documentation and must be inspected directly.
- `games/mitzvahWorld/experiments/awtsmoos/src/movie/` is referenced by generated docs and appears to contain a 3D/cinematic movie subsystem.
- `platform/creator-world-os/adapters/movieCompilerAdapter.mjs` is a cross-surface compiler bridge and must be inspected.
- `social-composer/js/reel/ReelMovieRenderer.js` is another render surface.

## Discovery graph
Movie capability
→ package/schema
→ timeline and sequencing
→ scene graph
→ render backends
→ AI command surface
→ mobile authoring UI
→ export/recording
→ test fixtures
→ showcase movie

## Required inspection before code
1. Enumerate exact app directories and entry points.
2. Read package manifests, route HTML, bootstrap modules, schemas, renderers, timelines, and tests.
3. Trace current 2D and 3D data models.
4. Find duplicate concepts: scene, clip, object, actor, camera, keyframe, effect, transition, text, particle, audio.
5. Find broken imports, oversized modules, stale experiments, incompatible schemas, and missing mobile affordances.
6. Locate existing three-minute or thirty-second movie fixtures and evidence folders.
7. Identify how apps are served locally and which browser routes can be tested.

## Non-negotiable architecture principles
- One canonical movie document model.
- Multiple adapters/renderers for product-specific behavior.
- Deterministic AI mutation commands with validation and stable IDs.
- Backward-compatible import adapters for legacy schemas.
- Shared timing, easing, keyframe, transform, camera, audio, text, shape, particle, and patch semantics.
- Mobile-first controls that remain efficient on desktop.
- Every touched source file remains small, readable, tab-indented, fully rewritten rather than partially patched.

## First-pass risks
- Existing apps may use incompatible coordinate, timing, or scene conventions.
- Export/recording may differ from preview runtime.
- 3D rendering may depend on game-specific world services.
- Browser autoplay/audio policies may affect verification.
- A visually rich 180-second movie can expose performance or memory leaks.

## Completion evidence required
- Source inspection proves all relevant movie surfaces were covered.
- Schema/API tests prove AI can author scenes and mutations.
- Unit/integration tests prove adapters preserve legacy inputs.
- Browser tests prove mobile authoring controls and playback work.
- The showcase document reports exactly 180 seconds.
- Browser/runtime evidence shows multiple scenes, cameras, people/characters, shapes, text, particles, 2D layers, 3D layers, transitions, and animated infographic/tutorial content.
- No known safe relevant work remains in the ledger.

The many vessels may differ in face, yet one inner grammar can restore,
Oros move through faithful keilim; one movie light can enter every door.
